looks.label: light pool
looks.technique: per-pixel darkness map seeded from the ambient level; each light carves a soft radial pool with quadratic falloff and a colour weight per light class; composite darkens each channel by the map

looks.label: carried light pool
looks.technique: a carried torch or lantern casts a moving pool

looks.label: roof cut
looks.technique: a light is cancelled when a wall, impassable or roof static sits above it in the diagonal cell

looks.label: dye ramp
looks.technique: one channel of each source pixel indexes a fixed-length ramp for whole-sprite recolour

looks.label: target cue on every layer
looks.technique: one highlight hue applied to every draw entry of the targeted mobile, equipment included

looks.label: shared-phase statics
looks.technique: one frame phase per static graphic id; every object of that graphic shares it

looks.label: walk cadence with sub-cell slide
looks.technique: body animation runs in step with a sub-cell slide; local avatar stays centred and the world scrolls

looks.label: minimap route panel
looks.technique: panel rotated to the world projection, route polyline and goal marker, redraw skipped when the signature is unchanged

originals.name: Hearth light pools
originals.idea: Soft radial light pools with a colour weight per light class over a darkness map, with a roof cut so interiors stay dark from outside (row 16 colour grade, zone ambience).
originals.keep: radial pool per light; colour weight per light class; roof cut
originals.change: computed in our fragment shader, not per pixel on the CPU; our own palette; the cut uses a zone interior flag instead of tile heights

originals.name: Shared-phase brazier
originals.idea: Every instance of one prop kind moves in one phase, so a row of braziers moves together (zone props; nearest parity row is 16 colour grade and zone ambience).
originals.change: each zone sets its own phase offset so neighbouring zones do not sync

originals.name: Dye-ramp gear tiers
originals.idea: One greyscale body with a fixed ramp per dye, chosen by one channel (row 15 gear dressing).
originals.keep: one body; ramp chosen by one channel
originals.change: a rarity palette in the shader, plus an accent ring so colour is never the only tier cue

originals.name: Target rim pulse
originals.idea: One cue on every layer of the target, equipment included (rows 11 fight camera and 14 HUD).
originals.change: an outline rim with a slow pulse, in a colour that never matches blood or the hit flash

originals.name: Route radar panel
originals.idea: A panel rotated to the world projection with the route and a goal marker, redrawn only when the route or player moves (row 14 HUD).
originals.keep: rotated to the world projection; route; goal marker; redraw on signature change
originals.change: fog-of-war reveal from zone geometry; touch corner toggle

originals.name: Hazard tile tags
originals.idea: A per-tile tag set for damaging, roof, surface and animated tiles (row 23 zone population).
originals.keep: per-tile tags for hazard, roof, surface and animated tiles
originals.change: named zone fields rather than bit flags; a trap telegraph before the hazard fires
